title: Everything Snowy
description: Makes EVERY block snowy like the Grass Block when a Snow layer is on top of it.
body:
A resourcepack that makes every block snowy (such as the Grass Block, Podzol and Mycelium) when a Snow layer is on top of them.

<details>
<summary>Issues</summary>

Translucent blocks (ex: Stained Glass) always show Z-Fighting when seen from afar no matter what even when the block faces are set ridiculously far from one another.

</details>
